about_the_game:
A first-person, physics-driven platforming adventure where gravity has gone wrong and the sky itself is broken.

In a world pulled upward into chaos, your mission isn’t just to climb — it’s to survive, adapt, and ultimately seal the colossal portal tearing reality apart.

Core Gameplay

  • Traverse a vertical world filled with floating debris and derelict structures.

  • Pull, stack, and reposition physics-based objects to forge paths through impossible spaces.

  • Solve environmental puzzles that test momentum, timing, and creativity.

Progression

  • Complete quests and objectives that push the story forward.

  • Collect and recycle trash to gain XP, unlock skills, and upgrade your toolkit.

  • Earn new movement abilities — from dashes and double jumps to gliding — that transform how you explore.

  • Discover gadgets like the Hook Module and Gravitor to manipulate the world around you.

The Goal

Shut down the portal in the sky before it consumes everything.

Your path upward is shaped by your choices, your problem-solving, and your mastery of physics in a broken world.
